# tools/dist/licenses -- the bundled libraries' licence texts the artifact ships

`build.sh` / `build.ps1` copy these verbatim into `dist/<platform>/licenses/`; the artifact never
depends on a build cache or a package manager for its licence texts. `tests/lint/lint_artifact_licenses.py`
(ctest `LintArtifactLicenses`) pins every file's SHA-256 to this table, checks the set each platform
stages, and checks the FFmpeg recipe (`tools/ci/ffmpeg_static.sh`) builds NO GPL component.

| File | Covers | Licence | Source (verbatim) | SHA-256 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SDL2-LICENSE.txt` | SDL2 `release-2.30.9` (`cmake/Sdl2Dependency.cmake`, built from source and linked statically by the `*-dist` presets) | zlib | https://raw.githubusercontent.com/libsdl-org/SDL/release-2.30.9/LICENSE.txt (= the fetched tree's `LICENSE.txt`) | `9b9e1764f06701bcf7ce21e942c682d5921ba0900c6fca760321b1c8837a9662` |
| `FFmpeg-LICENSE.md` | FFmpeg `n6.1.2` libavcodec / libavutil / libswscale (`tools/ci/ffmpeg_static.sh`) | LGPL v2.1 or later (the file names the per-component terms) | https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/n6.1.2/LICENSE.md | `cb48bf09a11f5fb576cddb0431c8f5ed0a60157a9ec942adffc13907cbe083f2` |
| `FFmpeg-COPYING.LGPLv2.1.txt` | the LGPL v2.1 text FFmpeg distributes | LGPL v2.1 | https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/n6.1.2/COPYING.LGPLv2.1 | `b634ab5640e258563c536e658cad87080553df6f34f62269a21d554844e58bfe` |
| `GCC-COPYING3.txt` | libstdc++ / libgcc (Linux: linked statically by `linux-dist`, `-static-libstdc++ -static-libgcc`) | GPL v3 ... | https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gcc-mirror/gcc/releases/gcc-13.3.0/COPYING3 | `8ceb4b9ee5adedde47b31e975c1d90c73ad27b6b165a1dcd80c7c545eb65b903` |
| `GCC-RUNTIME-LIBRARY-EXCEPTION.txt` | ... with the GCC Runtime Library Exception 3.1 (the exception that lets a non-GPL program ship the statically linked runtime) | GCC RLE 3.1 | https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gcc-mirror/gcc/releases/gcc-13.3.0/COPYING.RUNTIME | `9d6b43ce4d8de0c878bf16b54d8e7a10d9bd42b75178153e3af6a815bdc90f74` |
| `imgui-LICENSE.txt` | Dear ImGui v1.91.9b (`app/gui/third_party/imgui`, compiled into the binary; the F1 overlay and the launcher) | MIT | `app/gui/third_party/imgui/LICENSE.txt` (byte-equal; `PROVENANCE.md` there names the upstream commit) | `c80c5789748d955c4a650562baa0d750494e2c7128c2ca66aaebe2e3c4e198bf` |
| `imgl3w-UNLICENSE.txt` | the OpenGL loader compiled into the binary: ImGui's `imgui_impl_opengl3_loader.h` (gl3w-derived, generated by imgl3w). The engine itself uses NO loader library: it links the platform's GL (OpenGL.framework on macOS, `libGL.so.1` on Linux) and calls the exported entry points directly | public domain (Unlicense-style dedication) | the licence comment of `app/gui/third_party/imgui/backends/imgui_impl_opengl3_loader.h` | `7c4c66abdff581052136c558c42d134c44da831404279808fd390d6ae311c334` |

Not in this table, by design:

- **`stb` headers** inside Dear ImGui (`imstb_rectpack.h`, `imstb_textedit.h`, `imstb_truetype.h`): dual
  public domain / MIT, their notices are inside each header and are covered by `imgui-LICENSE.txt`'s
  distribution (ImGui's own `PROVENANCE.md`).
- **The recompiler's third parties** (`third_party/elfio` MIT, `third_party/rabbitizer` MIT): build-time
  tools; nothing of them is in the shipped binary.
- **macOS system libraries** (OpenGL.framework, libc++, libSystem): the user's own; nothing is bundled.
- **Linux system libraries at run time** (glibc, `libGL.so.1` via libglvnd/Mesa or the vendor driver, and the
  X11 / Wayland / PulseAudio / ALSA back ends SDL2 dlopen's): the user's own; nothing is bundled.
- **`FFmpeg-BUILD-CONFIGURATION.txt`** in the artifact is GENERATED at stage time from `tools/ci/ffmpeg_static.sh`
  (the tag + the exact `./configure` arguments) so the artifact carries the proof that no GPL or non-free
  component is compiled in (`--disable-gpl --disable-nonfree`, `--disable-everything` + the mpeg1/mpeg2
  decoders and the mpegvideo parser only).

LGPL v2.1 §6 for the statically linked FFmpeg: the "work that uses the Library" is this project, whose
complete source and the exact recipe that produces the shipped libavcodec/libavutil/libswscale
(`tools/ci/ffmpeg_static.sh`, pinned tag, configure arguments above) are published with the artifact's
BUILD-ID; a user can rebuild the artifact against a modified FFmpeg with `./build.sh` (`build.ps1`).

## Qt-LICENSE.LGPL3.txt

The GNU Lesser General Public License v3 text as shipped in the Qt 6 kits (`<kit>/Licenses/LICENSE.LGPL3`;
identical to https://www.gnu.org/licenses/lgpl-3.0.txt). Copied from the TwinsanityEvolved engine's committed
set (byte-identical, sha256 e3a994d82e644b03a792a930f574002658412f62407f5fee083f2555c5f23118). Used by
tools/ci/release_launcher.sh / .ps1 for the LAUNCHER artefacts only (the launcher links Qt 6 dynamically under
the LGPL v3; the game artefacts link no Qt). Shipped as licenses/Qt-LICENSE.LGPL3 beside the launcher when the
Qt kit on the packaging host carries no copy of its own.
